name: yt-cleaner
description: Chrome-tillägg som rensar YouTube till bara video, titel, kanal och beskrivning.

scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s icons/icon.svg -o icons/icon-$s.png; done
scripts.pack: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/yt-cleaner.zip && zip -r dist/yt-cleaner.zip manifest.json src _locales icons -x icons/icon.svg
